definition: to look like someone or something
description: A park path on a sunny autumn day, with a lake, ducks and a black lamp post. A young woman with a huge mass of curly light-brown hair, in a rust jumper and black leggings, jogs along the path. Right beside her an apricot poodle with exactly the same fluffy curly hair walks along a green bench on its back legs, its mouth open like hers. Behind them a young woman in a green jacket and a young man in a tan jacket laugh and point at the pair.
